body.html: J2 Hotel Kpp is a 3-star hotel that opened in 2024, located in Nakhon Chum, Mueang Kamphaeng Phet, on the west bank of the Ping River · it is a stylish white building with 34 rooms, a spacious car park, and security on duty · because it is a new property, travellers looking for clean, fresh rooms at a midrange price gravitate here — business visitors, tourists stopping in Kamphaeng Phet on the way to Sukhothai, and families wanting a roomy suite with an extra bed.

Rooms range from Deluxe Twin, Grand Deluxe King and Grand Deluxe Twin — some with Ping River views — to a Family Suite with a king bed and bunk bed for families · the praise you see most is that the rooms are new, clean, nicely decorated, with comfortable beds and well-working bathrooms · every room has air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, fridge, kettle, safe and a private bathroom with a shower · some have a balcony, and a river-facing room gives a lovely view of the Ping, which many guests singled out as a favourite.
"A brand-new property — a pretty white building, nice atmosphere, clean rooms with everything you need, helpful staff, plenty of parking and security on duty, so it felt safe."

The facilities fit a hotel of this level · there is free Wi-Fi throughout, free spacious parking, an à la carte breakfast, an on-site restaurant, and a 24-hour front desk · the trade-off to know up front is that there is no pool, no gym, and no airport shuttle, as this is a small room-focused hotel · breakfast is à la carte single dishes rather than a multi-item buffet, so if you like plenty of choice it may feel a little limited.

The location is on the Nakhon Chum side, near the Ping River · it is about 500 metres from Sirijit Park and the cultural conservation plaza, walkable to the riverside and Nakhon Chum market · it sits on the opposite bank from the Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park, about 10–15 minutes by car across the bridge · the Nakhon Chum area around it has plenty of restaurants and cafés · it suits travellers who want a quiet riverside setting while staying easy reach of town · the overall score sits around 8.7 from real reviews, with Booking around 8.8 and Trip.com around 8.7.

To be straight with you, J2 Hotel Kpp is a small new hotel, not a full-facility resort · there is no pool, no gym, breakfast is single-dish à la carte, and it sits on the Nakhon Chum bank, the opposite side from the Historical Park, so you need a car ride across the bridge · if your main plan is the Historical Park and you have no car, it may feel a touch far · but if you see it as new, clean, stylish rooms, some river-facing, at a midrange price with spacious parking and good security — it is a standout among the newer hotels of Kamphaeng Phet.

A tip from reading the reviews here: if you want the best view, ask for a Grand Deluxe room on the river side when you book, as not every room sees the Ping · families should pick the Family Suite with its bunk bed rather than booking two rooms · having your own car is the most convenient, since the hotel is on the Nakhon Chum side and reaching town or the Historical Park needs a drive · breakfast is single-dish à la carte, so for more variety head out to Nakhon Chum market or local eateries · and always compare the live price on Agoda and Booking before you book, as rates move with the season and promotions.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — J2 Hotel Kpp Kamphaeng Phet

faq.q: Where is J2 Hotel Kpp and what is nearby?
faq.a: It is at 5/5 Moo 2, Nakhon Chum, Mueang Kamphaeng Phet, on the west bank of the Ping River · about 500 metres from the Sirijit cultural plaza and Sirijit Park, walkable to the riverside · it sits on the opposite bank from the Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park, about 10–15 minutes by car across the bridge, suiting travellers who want a quiet riverside stay while staying within easy reach of town.

faq.q: How much does J2 Hotel Kpp cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿850/night for a Deluxe Twin · there is a Grand Deluxe King around ฿1,050, a river-view Grand Deluxe Twin around ฿1,150, and a Family Suite with a bunk bed around ฿1,500 · rates move with the season and promotions, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is J2 Hotel Kpp best for?
faq.a: It suits business visitors, tourists stopping in Kamphaeng Phet on the way to Sukhothai, and families wanting fresh clean rooms who want a new, nicely decorated property, some rooms with Ping River views, at a midrange price with spacious parking and good security · it is best for travellers driving their own car.

faq.q: Does J2 Hotel Kpp have a pool or other facilities?
faq.a: It has free Wi-Fi throughout, free spacious parking, an à la carte breakfast, an on-site restaurant, and a 24-hour front desk with security on duty · it is a small hotel, so there is no swimming pool, no gym, and no airport shuttle — the focus is on new, clean rooms.

faq.q: What are the rooms at J2 Hotel Kpp like?
faq.a: New, clean, nicely decorated modern rooms with comfortable beds is the praise you see most, as the hotel opened in 2024 · every room has AC, a flat-screen TV, fridge, kettle, safe and a private bathroom with a shower · some have a balcony with a Ping River view, so ask for a river-side Grand Deluxe room when booking if you want the view.

faq.q: Are the review scores for J2 Hotel Kpp reliable?
faq.a: J2 Hotel Kpp has 34 rooms and an overall score around 8.7 from real reviews, with Booking around 8.8 and Trip.com around 8.7 · its strengths are newness, cleanliness, stylish rooms and the riverside Ping setting · it is a good pick if you want a new, clean-room hotel at a midrange price in Kamphaeng Phet.
